ios.desc:
For minds not limited to the mundane world... see what is beneath our visible reality. 

Based on real data from practicing scientists, 10k Science brings the world of the unseen from 100-million-times normal human vision directly to the device in your hand. 

10k Science is a tool that:
• Engages you in complex science no matter your age or experience
• Guides you in an intelligent, Socratic-style exploration of scientific problems
• Challenges you to think about the world at vastly different scales

Funded by the National Institutes of Health, the National Science Foundation, and in collaboration with the Lawrence Hall of Science at UC Berkeley, we bring you an ever-expanding library of experiences - from the depths of the ocean to inside the human bloodstream.

10k Science is a living platform: we are constantly working on new content, and your feedback is taken to heart by a small, bootstrapped team. 

Background: 10k Science was created by the developers of the app, Powers of Minus Ten, which was featured by Apple multiple times and was in the iPad 2 commercial, "Alive". 10k Science in many ways is the successor to Powers of Minus Ten, but featuring more advanced, scientifically-accurate visualizations and AI capabilities, and extensive testing in authentic educational environments.
